  "salesInvoices.emptyBody": "الفاتورة هي ما يُسجّل البيع: تُخرج البضاعة من المستودع وتُقيّد المديونية على العميل عند تأكيدها.",
  "items.emptyBody": "الصنف هو وحدة الكتالوج — كل ما يُشترى أو يُباع أو يُخزَّن، بسعره ووحدته وحساباته.",
  "suppliers.emptyBody": "المورد هو الطرف الذي تُسجَّل عليه فواتير الشراء ويُتابَع سداده — أضف أول مورد لتبدأ.",
  "employees.emptyBody": "ملف الموظف يجمع بياناته الشخصية وتعاقده وراتبه، وعليه تُبنى الحضور والإجازات والرواتب.",
  "departments.emptyBody": "الإدارة تجمع الموظفين تحت مسؤول واحد، وتصلح أساساً لمراكز التكلفة وتقارير الرواتب.",
  "jobTitles.emptyBody": "المسمى الوظيفي يربط الموظف بإدارته ودرجته، ويظهر على العقد وكشف الراتب.",

  "payroll.emptyBody": "مسيّر الرواتب يحسب صافي الأجر لكل موظف عن فترة محددة، ويُقيّده في دفتر اليومية عند اعتماده.",
  "payrollComponents.emptyBody": "المكوّن هو أي بند استحقاق أو استقطاع يظهر على كشف الراتب — بدل، حافز، تأمين أو ضريبة.",
  "attendance.emptyBody": "سجل الحضور يحفظ حضور وانصراف كل موظف يومياً، وعليه تُحسب الساعات الإضافية والخصومات.",
  "holidays.emptyBody": "العطلة الرسمية تُستثنى من أيام العمل، فلا تُحتسب ضمن رصيد الإجازات ولا خصومات الغياب.",
  "leavePolicies.emptyBody": "سياسة الإجازات تحدد رصيد كل نوع إجازة وقواعد ترحيله واستحقاقه.",

  "leaveBalances.emptyBody": "الرصيد يبيّن ما استحقه الموظف من كل نوع إجازة وما استهلكه منه.",
  "leaveAccrual.emptyBody": "دفعة الاستحقاق تضيف رصيد الإجازات المستحق لكل موظف عن الفترة، دفعة واحدة.",
  "treasuryAcc.emptyBody": "الخزينة أو الحساب البنكي هو المكان الذي تدخل منه النقدية وتخرج — ولكلٍّ رصيده وحسابه في دليل الحسابات.",
  "vouchers.emptyBody": "السند يسجل كل حركة نقدية: قبض من عميل، صرف لمورد، أو تحويل بين خزينتين — وكلٌّ منها قيد متوازن.",
  "cheques.emptyBody": "الشيك يُسجَّل هنا من لحظة استلامه أو تحريره حتى تحصيله أو ارتداده، وكل حالة تحرّك النقدية أو المديونية.",
  "bankRec.emptyBody": "المطابقة البنكية تقارن كشف البنك بحركات الخزينة المسجّلة، وتُظهر ما لم يُطابَق بعد.",
  "journals.emptyBody": "قيد اليومية هو الطريق اليدوي إلى دفتر الأستاذ — مدين يساوي دائن، وبتاريخ داخل فترة مفتوحة.",

export type WebTranslationKey = keyof typeof webAr;
 
/**
 * The keys this catalogue actually ships. `translate` humanizes a key it does
 * not know rather than leaking it, so a caller overlaying translations onto
 * server-supplied copy cannot tell "translated" from "invented" without this.
 */
export const WEB_TRANSLATION_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(Object.keys(webAr));

  // R1.10 — every list carries an empty state that says what the record is and offers the way to create one
  "quotes.emptyBody": "A quote comes before the invoice: it fixes the items and their prices for a stated validity window, and turns into a sales invoice once it is accepted.",
  "salesInvoices.emptyBody": "The invoice is what records the sale: confirming it issues the goods from the warehouse and puts the amount onto what the customer owes.",
  "items.emptyBody": "An item is the unit of the catalogue — anything bought, sold or stocked, with its price, its unit and its accounts.",
  "suppliers.emptyBody": "A supplier is who you record purchase invoices against and pay — add the first one to get started.",
  "employees.emptyBody": "An employee record holds their personal details, their contract and their pay, and everything in attendance, leave and payroll is built on it.",
  "departments.emptyBody": "A department groups employees under one manager, and doubles as the basis for cost centres and payroll reporting.",
  "jobTitles.emptyBody": "A job title ties an employee to their department and grade, and appears on the contract and the payslip.",
  "contracts.emptyBody": "A contract sets how long the employee is engaged for, their basic pay and their end-of-service terms.",
  "advances.emptyBody": "An advance is a debt owed by the employee, recovered from their next payslips in instalments.",
  "payroll.emptyBody": "A payroll run computes each employee's net pay for a period, and posts it to the journal once it is approved.",
  "payrollComponents.emptyBody": "A component is any earning or deduction that shows on a payslip — an allowance, a bonus, insurance or tax.",
  "attendance.emptyBody": "The attendance record holds each employee's daily in and out, and overtime and absence deductions are computed from it.",
  "holidays.emptyBody": "A public holiday is excluded from working days, so it counts neither against leave balance nor as absence.",
  "leavePolicies.emptyBody": "A leave policy sets the entitlement for each leave type and the rules for accruing and carrying it forward.",
  "leaveRequests.emptyBody": "A leave request goes through the manager's approval and then comes off the employee's balance.",
  "leaveBalances.emptyBody": "The balance shows what each employee has accrued of every leave type and how much of it they have used.",
  "leaveAccrual.emptyBody": "An accrual batch adds the leave each employee earned over the period, in one run.",
  "treasuryAcc.emptyBody": "A till or bank account is where cash comes in and goes out — each with its own balance and its own account in the chart.",
  "vouchers.emptyBody": "A voucher records every movement of cash: a collection from a customer, a payment to a supplier, or a transfer between tills — each one a balanced entry.",
  "cheques.emptyBody": "A cheque is tracked here from the moment it is received or written until it clears or bounces, and every state moves either cash or a debt.",
  "bankRec.emptyBody": "Bank reconciliation compares the bank's statement against the treasury movements you recorded, and shows what is still unmatched.",
  "journals.emptyBody": "A journal entry is the manual route into the ledger — debit equal to credit, dated inside an open period.",
  "taxes.emptyBody": "A tax applies to invoice lines at the rate and against the account set here.",
  "fiscalPeriods.emptyBody": "A fiscal period decides what may be posted into it — an open one accepts entries, a locked one refuses them for good.",

  "specs.emptyBody": "A specification is a reusable attribute — a colour, a size, a material — that item variants are built from.",
  "templates.emptyBody": "A product template generates many items from a set of attributes, instead of creating every variant by hand.",
  "configProducts.emptyBody": "A configurable product is priced and manufactured to the customer's choices, not stocked ready-made.",
  "customOrders.emptyBody": "A custom order turns a customer's choices on a configurable product into a work order and a price.",
  "writedown.emptyBody": "An inventory write-down compares cost against net realisable value and books the difference as an expense.",
  "asset.emptyBody": "An asset is registered at its cost and useful life, then depreciated periodically down to its residual value.",
  "assetCategories.emptyBody": "A category sets the depreciation method and the accounts for every asset registered under it.",
  "depreciation.emptyBody": "A depreciation run computes the period's charge for every asset and posts it to the ledger in one go.",
  "projects.emptyBody": "A project gathers the revenue and cost of one contract, so its profit reads separately from the rest of the business.",
  "instalments.emptyBody": "An instalment plan splits a confirmed sales invoice into dated instalments, each collected and followed up on its own.",

  "leads.emptyBody": "A lead is a name before it becomes a customer — qualified first, then converted into an opportunity.",
  "opportunities.emptyBody": "An opportunity is a deal under negotiation with an expected value and a stage, advancing until it is won or lost.",
  "activities.emptyBody": "An activity records a call, a visit or a follow-up task against a customer or an opportunity.",
  "pipelineStages.emptyBody": "A stage defines the steps of the sales pipeline, from the first opportunity through to close.",
